variables.name: primitives/alphas/aliases/transparent
variables.description: Fully transparent. Use to disable a color without removing the layer; helpful for state transitions and hover-to-focus animations.

variables.name: primitives/alphas/aliases/tint-whisper
variables.description: Use for table row hovers, very light brand washes, and background subtlety without shifting hierarchy.

variables.name: primitives/alphas/aliases/emphasis-hairline
variables.description: Use for divider highlights, pressed states on dark themes, and low-contrast chips; maintains legibility while hinting interaction.

variables.name: primitives/alphas/aliases/surface-subtle
variables.description: Use for default ambient overlay on modals/drawers, disabled icon fills, and low-elevation shadows; preserves underlying content.

variables.name: primitives/alphas/aliases/overlay-light
variables.description: Use for secondary button hovers, selected list items, and neutral scrims on light backgrounds; noticeable but gentle.

variables.name: primitives/alphas/aliases/overlay-medium
variables.description: Use for active states, input focus backgrounds, and side-panel tints; creates clear separation without feeling heavy.

variables.name: primitives/alphas/aliases/overlay-strong
variables.description: Use for primary button hovers on dark backgrounds, selected tiles, and callout backdrops; balances weight and readability.

variables.name: primitives/alphas/aliases/semi-opaque
variables.description: Use for scrims behind dialogs, image dimming for text legibility, and high-contrast chips; content beneath remains visible.

variables.name: primitives/alphas/aliases/emphatic-fill
variables.description: Use for side sheets and tool palettes needing solid presence while showing context; good for brand-colored panels.

variables.name: primitives/alphas/aliases/near-opaque
variables.description: Use for alerts, banners, and sticky headers that must dominate the surface; text contrast requirements are easier to meet.
